history.title: Historical Record
info.content:
TransTools is a voice data analysis tool.

It allows you to record your voice, analyze properties such as pitch (tone), and track evolution over time.
info.features_content:
• Record voice samples with configurable duration (5–60 seconds)
• Analyze pitch (mean, min, max, std) and energy (RMS)
• Optional mood tags (happy, sad, angry)
• Historical record with table and pitch chart
• Export data to CSV for external analysis
• Customizable interface (colors, fonts, language)
info.privacy_content: This application does NOT collect personal data. All recordings and analysis results are stored locally on your device. No data is sent to external servers.
info.disclaimer_content: TransTools is a data analyzer only. It does NOT provide therapeutic conclusions or medical advice. Consult your doctor or a qualified professional for clinical interpretation of your voice data.
